A tone-matched leather belt defines the waist for standing, while silver jewelry provides a single focal point without breaking the somber mood."},{"id":"o2","caption":"Structured silk top and fitted midi skirt with loafers","items":["#237·13","#138·22","#108·27","#264·07","#406·31"],"day":"A soft silk blouse balances a structured cotton skirt, keeping the silhouette vertical. Fitted loafers continue the leg line to the midi hem for walking comfort; silver ring adds contrast without color."},{"id":"o5","caption":"Tonal grey poncho and wide-leg trousers with belt","items":["#120·30","#69·12","#427·22","#398·36","#128·10"],"day":"This monochromatic set uses tonal steps from dark graphite to soft grey to draw the eye vertically. A black leather belt defines the waist and removes shoulder volume; cashmere scarf adds texture near the face."},{"id":"o6","caption":"Quilted tweed jacket and brown alpaca mini skirt","items":["#22·27","#81·22","#406·31","#427·22","#178·05"],"day":"The quilted tweed adds warm texture to the cold autumn morning. A black leather belt defines the waist against the chocolate alpaca skirt; silver ring and gold necklace provide necessary metallic contrast for formal respect."},{"id":"o9","caption":"Dark bomber jacket and straight wool trousers with knee boots","items":["#361·12","#87·12","#300·06","#378·31","#407·12"],"day":"The dark chocolate bomber provides weather protection for the cemetery walk; paired with straight wool trousers to maintain smart formality.
